packs.title: Gardens, Science and River
packs.promise: Explore gardens, landforms, science and the Willamette across separate Portland outings.

q.s: Compare two labeled rose beds without needing flowers in bloom.
st: Compare one visible leaf or growth feature.
Distinguish your observation from the garden’s testing purpose.

q.s: Notice how a garden path frames a view.
st: Choose an open path or an official garden image.
Write a quiet three-sentence view description.

q.s: Plan a short arboretum route around two labeled trees.
st: Use the arboretum map to choose a short route from the visitor center.
Locate two labeled trees on open paths.
Record distance, slope and a turnaround rather than attempting every trail.

packs.title: Park Blocks to Pearl
packs.promise: Follow a connected downtown route from the Cultural District to books and Pearl District parks.

q.s: Trace how two park blocks connect across a street.
st: Mark the controlled crossing and a public place to pause.
Draw a short route showing where park ends and street begins.

q.s: Read one historical object’s context and leave a research question.
st: Choose an open exhibit or an official OHS collection story.
Note its maker or source and one context point.
Write a question the record does not answer.

q.s: Compare your first observation with a museum’s account.
st: Choose one museum work in an open gallery or the museum collection website.
Write one visual observation before reading its label.
Add one sourced context point and keep the two distinct.
